items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Mr. Field, I’ve got to tell you, I’m a musician... And then he said to me, “And if it doesn’t work out, Peter, you’ve still got a job here.”

ctx.x: And he looked like a gangster, dressed so smart and he’d stand there. And if he was doing this much he was really animated you know. So I came in this Saturday and he said, “Where do you go on a Saturday afternoon?” I said, “Mr. Field, I’ve got to tell you, I’m a musician and I do this matinee. I’ve really waited a year for the union card and I would appreciate it, I’m awfully sorry, anything I can do? Some extra hours?” “What time do you finish at night?” I said, “One in the morning.” Oh yeah, and you have to…
